blocks.content: The copy() function copies a range of values to some new destination. Let's see the function signature first.
iterator copy(iterator first, iterator last, new_iterator destination_first);

items: first : Iterator to the first element of the range.
last : iterator to the last element of the range.
destination_first : iterator to the destination container.

blocks.content: This function returns an iterator to the element in the destination container which is one past the last element copied.
